source: EnterpriseRAG-Bench paper, Sun/Rahmfeld/Weaver/Desai/Huang/Butler, arXiv:2605.05253, Tables 6 and 7
note: arXiv:2609.05637 cites this paper as its benchmark source. Metric is Document Recall@10 over the 470 questions carrying gold documents; correctness is a GPT-5.4 judge, not used here.

systems.BM25: OpenSearch, standard analyzer, single concatenated text field, fixed top-10 documents
systems.Vector: OpenAI text-embedding-3-large, 3072 dimensions, cosine over Qdrant, fixed top-10 documents
systems.BashAgent: GPT-5.4 low reasoning with grep/find/head over the corpus directory, variable document count, 10-minute budget

authors_own_wording: BM25 leads on correctness and document recall. Vector search underperforms expectations even on semantic questions (32.8% correctness, 24.8% recall), the category explicitly designed to favor embedding-based retrieval by limiting keyword overlap.
